about: Queue for the Strong Knees (Knees) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/knees.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/knees/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "knees".

clips.name: Heel Slides
clips.start: lying on his back, both legs straight on the floor, arms flat by his sides.
clips.motion: keeping the right heel on the floor, he slides it toward his glute so the right knee bends as far as it comfortably goes, pauses, then slides it back out until the leg is straight. Only the right leg moves and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Clamshells
clips.start: lying on his left side, head resting on the left arm, hips and knees bent at about 45 degrees with the knees and heels stacked together, right hand on the right hip.
clips.motion: keeping the heels touching and the hips stacked, he opens the right knee up toward the ceiling like a clamshell, pauses, then lowers it back onto the left knee. He never rolls back and never switches sides.
clips.glow: only the outer right hip, the muscle on the side of the right hip just below the waistband, under the shorts and glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute. No glow on the thighs or the left side. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Wall Sit
clips.start: sitting against a wall with the back flat on it, knees bent at about 90 degrees directly above the ankles, feet hip width apart, arms crossed over the chest.
clips.motion: keeping his back flat on the wall, he slides down a few centimetres lower, pauses, then slides back up to the 90 degree position. He never stands all the way up.
clips.glow: only the front of both thighs (the quads), from the knees all the way up under the shorts to the hips, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
clips.start: lying on his left side, head resting on the left arm, left leg straight, right knee bent with the right hand holding the right ankle behind him.
clips.motion: keeping the knees side by side, he gently pulls the right heel toward the right glute and pushes the right hip forward, pauses, then eases off a little. He never lets go of the ankle and never switches sides.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg, the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Prone Hamstring Curl
clips.start: lying face down, legs straight, forehead resting on the stacked hands.
clips.motion: keeping the hips pressed into the floor, he bends only the right knee and curls the right heel toward the glute, pauses, then lowers it slowly to the floor. Only the right leg moves and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg, the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Box Step-Up
clips.start: standing facing a low box, right foot flat on top of the box, left foot on the floor, hands on the hips.
clips.motion: pushing through the right foot, he straightens the right leg and stands up on the box, bringing the left foot up to hover beside the right foot without touching the box, pauses, then slowly lowers the left foot back to the floor. The right foot stays on the box the whole time and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute, the big muscle on the back of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
clips.start: lying on his back, right knee bent with the right foot flat on the floor, left leg straight and raised to the height of the right knee, arms flat by his sides.
clips.motion: pushing through the right heel, he lifts his hips until they are level with the right knee, pauses, then lowers them to the floor. The left leg stays straight in the air and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right glute, the big muscle on the back of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts, and the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Box Step-Down
clips.start: standing on top of a low box on the right leg, left leg straight and hovering in front of the box, hands on the hips.
clips.motion: bending only the right knee forward over the toes, he slowly lowers until the left heel lightly taps the floor in front of the box, then straightens the right leg to stand tall again. The right foot never leaves the box and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Heels-Elevated Squat
clips.start: standing with both heels raised on a thin wooden plank about 3 centimetres high, toes on the floor, feet hip width apart, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
clips.motion: keeping the torso upright and the heels on the plank, he squats straight down until his hips are below his knees with the knees travelling far forward over the toes, pauses, then stands back up. He never lifts the heels off the plank.
clips.glow: only the front of both thighs (the quads), from the knees all the way up under the shorts to the hips, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Reverse Lunge
clips.start: standing tall, feet together, hands on the hips.
clips.motion: keeping the right foot planted, he steps the left foot far back and lowers until the left knee is just above the floor and the right thigh is parallel to the floor, pauses, then pushes through the right foot to bring the left foot back beside it. He only ever steps back with the left foot and never alternates legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute, the big muscle on the back of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left thigh or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Split Squat Hold
clips.start: in a split stance, right foot flat in front, left foot far behind on the ball of the foot, sunk down so the right thigh is parallel to the floor and the left knee hovers just above the floor, torso upright, hands on the hips.
clips.motion: holding the bottom position, he sinks a few centimetres lower, pauses, then rises a few centimetres back to the hold. He never stands up and never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute, the big muscle on the back of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left thigh or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Single Leg Box Squat
clips.start: standing in front of a knee-height box on the right foot only, left leg straight and lifted just off the floor in front, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
clips.motion: on the right leg only, he slowly sits back and down until his glutes lightly touch the box, then stands back up on the right leg. The left foot never touches the floor and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute, the big muscle on the back of the right hip under the shorts, glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
